desc: A majestic compact coiled sea-dragon spirit: violet body, black void face with two small white eyes, pale gold lightning horns and fins, gold rings, grandest design. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
